name: Fisheye Hover Gallery
description: Staggered grid of grayscale photos with numbered labels. Hovering a photo swaps it for a WebGL fisheye render with chromatic aberration, noise and vignette that follows the cursor.
contents: Grid of numbered images, each with a small title below
One WebGL canvas per image for the hover effect
behavior: On hover the image fades out and a shader canvas fades in, with fisheye distortion easing in
Cursor position bends the distortion locally
Title shifts right, greys out and shows a bullet marker on hover
Canvases resize with their image box
Below 768px the grid becomes two columns
editableByProps: Heading, images, labels, numbers and grid placement through each item className
Strength, radius, aberration, noise, vignette and mouse response of the fisheye effect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the grayscale resting look of the images
needsCodeEdit.where: grayscale contrast-[1.2] classes on the img element

fixed: Effect is hover driven and uses one WebGL context per image, so keep the image count moderate
Images must allow cross-origin loading for the WebGL textures
Grid placement classes in the default images use md: prefixes, below that the grid is two columns
